main_text.l: Dei erga creaturam corruptam atq; pec-
neum esse putauit cum doctrina Calvi-
ni, Comm. in Ezechielem, cap. 18. v.

l.i: mat eandem sententiam, aliys verbis, Deum
scilicet nihil magis cupere, quàm ut qui-
cunque peribant, & ruebant in mortem, re-
deant in viam salutis. Et hac etiam de
causa non modo hodie Euangelium pro-
mulgatur in mundo, sed omnibus saeculis
voluit Deus testatum esse quàm propensus sit
vis lege & prophetis carerent, tamen semper
gustu aliquo huius doctrina fuerunt praditi.
Verum quidem est suffocatam fuisse mul-
tis erroribus ; sed reperiemus semper arca-
no impulsu fuisse adductos ad petendam
veniam, quia hic sensus quodammodo in-
genitus illis erat, Deum esse omnibus qui

main_text.l: rius id Deus in lege & Prophetis testatus

l.i: est. In Euangelio autem scimus quàm fa-
miliariter nos compellet, vbi promittit no-

main_text.l: bis veniam. Neque verò aliter Ethnici

page.notes: The first line is set as running text, not as a running head. The page ends mid-sentence at the foot of the scan. The word "fferat" is marked [?] because the start of the word is unclear. The text is set in bold; italic passages are marked. Printed "vt" and "Calui-" are given as "ut" and "Calvi-" under the spelling rule for u/v. Per the instructions, the printed forms are left as they are. The first line is a fragment, continuing from the part of the page above the cut. Some words are set in roman and some in italic, and the boundaries in "Deus in lege" and "Prophetis" were hard to tell apart. The initial "de" in the last line has a decorative flourish. The "E" of "Ethnici" is partly damaged but reads as printed. Spelling is as printed, with long s written as s and u/v normalised.
